newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil product markets quiet, prices mostly stead.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil product markets quiet, prices mostly stead.

text.p: NWE oil products markets were quiet on Wednesday with most prices holding firm, traders said.
Gasoline in was steady in a very dull market. Eurograde first-half delivery June barges talked at $208/$209.
Naphtha was steady in a dead market. The last heard physical deal was at $184 cif Rotterdam for a 14,000 Dow spec cargo.
Gas oil was little changed with barges pegged around IPE June +75 cents fob Flushing/Antwerp and +$2.50 fob Rotterdam.
Fuel barges dipped on poor bunker demand but low sulphur swaps were boosted by firm crude. They stood at $96.50/$97.25 with physical notionally around $95 fob.
